title: Secured transactions and bankruptcy — Ridge Fabrication
instructions: Ridge Fabrication borrowed from several creditors in 2025 and later filed a Chapter 7 petition. Answer each question.

exhibits.title: Credit history
exhibits.content:
- **Bank A** obtained a security agreement covering all of Ridge's present and after-acquired equipment and filed a financing statement on **January 10**; it lent the money on **January 15**.
- **Seller B** sold Ridge a new machine on credit, retaining a purchase money security interest. Ridge received the machine on **February 1**; Seller B filed on **February 15**.
- **Lender C** took a security interest in Ridge's inventory and filed on **March 1**. A customer bought inventory from Ridge in the ordinary course of business in April.
- On **May 20**, while insolvent, Ridge paid a trade creditor $15,000 on an invoice from January. Ridge filed its Chapter 7 petition on **June 10**.

exhibits.title: Bankruptcy estate
exhibits.content: After secured creditors are paid from their collateral, **$200,000** remains. Claims: administrative expenses $30,000; employee wages within the statutory limit $20,000; priority income taxes $50,000; general unsecured claims $400,000.

rows.label: When did Bank A's security interest attach?
rows.explanation: Attachment requires value, an authenticated agreement and rights in the collateral; value was given January 15.

rows.label: Who has priority in the new machine?
options: Bank A, because it filed first
Seller B, because its PMSI was perfected within 20 days of delivery
rows.answer: Seller B, because its PMSI was perfected within 20 days of delivery
rows.explanation: UCC 9-324(a): a PMSI in equipment perfected within 20 days after the debtor receives possession has priority over an earlier-filed interest.

rows.label: The customer who bought inventory in April takes it:
options: Free of Lender C's security interest
Subject to Lender C's security interest
Subject to Lender C's interest unless it searched the filings
rows.answer: Free of Lender C's security interest
rows.explanation: A buyer in the ordinary course takes free of a security interest created by the seller, even if perfected.

rows.label: The May 20 payment to the trade creditor is:
options: A voidable preference the trustee can recover
Protected because it paid a valid debt
Avoidable only if Ridge intended to defraud
rows.answer: A voidable preference the trustee can recover
rows.explanation: A transfer to an unsecured creditor on an antecedent debt within 90 days before filing, while insolvent, that gives more than Chapter 7 would, is a preference.
